sources.snippet: ACS on MedMNIST: all checkpoints and per-cell artifacts This repo holds every trained model behind the paper's tables. That covers ACS (class-conditional coverage + per-class purity filter + budget-dependent herding/coverage switch) and all compared one-shot data-selection methods on MedMNIST 2D at 2% / 5% budgets.

sources.title: MedMNIST
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce MedMNIST, a large-scale MNIST-like collection of standardized biomedical images, including 12 datasets for 2D and 6 datasets for 3D. All images are pre-processed into 28x28 (2D) or 28x28x28 (3D) with the corresponding classification labels, so that no background knowledge is required for users. sources.title: medmnist · PyPI
sources.snippet: Covering primary data modalities in biomedical images, MedMNIST is designed to perform classification on lightweight 2D and 3D images with various data scales (from 100 to 100,000) and diverse tasks (binary/multi-class, ordinal regression and multi-label).
